review.headline: 46-min easy ride completed as planned, with HR held at 126 avg, consistent with RPE 4.
observations: Ride took 2760 s (46 min) against a planned 45 min, so the duration matched the plan.
Average HR 126 and max HR 134 stayed low, consistent with an easy spin at RPE 4.
Splits were even, with every km at 117 s, which shows a steady effort throughout.
The 1:57/km pace field is a running-derived value and does not describe the ride; the 23.5 km in 46 min averages about 30.6 km/h.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so perceived effort is unconfirmed.
Cadence and elevation show 0, which may mean missing sensor data.
Weekly volume is well below plan: week 2 has 6.0 km run against 45 planned, and CTL has fallen from 44.4 to 31.7 over the last 15 days.
